title: Rooftop Puppy Yoga at BLVD
description: Chill out with pups and stretch under the sun at our Rooftop Puppy Yoga overlooking the Las Vegas Strip!
long_description:
Chill out with pups and stretch under the sun at our Rooftop Puppy Yoga overlooking the Las Vegas Strip!

About this Event

Rooftop Puppy YogaGet ready for rooftop yoga surrounded by adorable adoptable puppies on the beautiful BLVD rooftop! 
This event is perfect for anyone looking to relax, stretch, and have a blast with furry friends. Whether you're a yoga pro or just here for the cuddles, this is your chance to unwind and meet some playful pups under the open sky. 
Don’t miss out on this unique and fun experience!

Also check out other in Las Vegas, Health & Wellness events in Las Vegas.
